sections.title: 1. N+1 query patterns
2. Unnecessary React re-renders
3. Caching opportunities
sections.content:
**Workspace-id resolution duplicated 46x across 12 files** — `resolveWorkspaceId` reimplements the same `current_user_default_workspace` RPC call independently in `design-memory.functions.ts`, `deployments.functions.ts`, `billing.functions.ts`, etc. Any page that fires several server functions in parallel without an explicit workspace id pays N identical round trips in the same request. Fix: resolve once in the `requireSupabaseAuth` middleware context and thread it through, rather than re-resolving per function.

React Query's global config (`router.tsx:105-110`) already sets `staleTime: 30_000` + `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` — that's already correctly tuned, no gap there.

sections.title: 4. Memory leaks
5. Redundant computations
sections.content:
**`ranking.ts`** — `compareOpportunities` calls `verdictFor()` on every pairwise `sort` comparison (O(n log n) calls instead of n). Cheap today, but it's the kind of comparator that grows expensive later without anyone noticing:
```ts
const decorated = opps.map(o => ({ o, v: verdictRankOf(verdictFor(o)) }));
decorated.sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v || compareRest(a.o, b.o, corroborationOf));
```

**Three near-duplicate relative-time formatters** (`format.ts`, `decisions-shared.ts`, `ship-format.ts`) — confirmed O(1) each, lists are low-hundreds of rows at most. This is a maintainability cleanup, not a real perf win.

No O(n²) patterns found in the knowledge-graph code — `knowledge-graph-view.ts` uses `Map`/`Set` lookups throughout.

---
**Priority order if you want me to fix any of these**: the `AccountConnectionsSection` leak (#4) and the design-memory N+1 (#1) are the two with concrete user-visible impact — the leak wastes network/battery post-navigation, the insert loop adds real latency to every design-language extraction. Want me to patch either one now?
